turns.speaker: agent

turns.text: Okay, I've that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.text: I'll try to pay $1570 Sep 30.

turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $1,570.00 on September 30. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other questions for me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
